flatirons-community-church-lafayette-co.assessment: Flatirons Community Church is the largest church in Colorado, led by Jim Burgen since 2006. Burgen has a youth ministry background and entertainment-industry connections. The church is classified as 'Unclear: Non-Affirming' by Church Clarity on LGBTQ issues — they do not affirm same-sex relationships but have been deliberately unclear about their stance. This ambiguity is itself a yellow/red flag for doctrinal clarity. The seeker-sensitive megachurch model, combined with theological ambiguity on key cultural issues, suggests prioritizing growth over doctrinal precision. Not recommended for those seeking clear theological conviction.
